```{r}
# Load BP and PP environmental measurements
PB_PP <- read.csv(
  data_file("metadata/environmental/WP2_Spring_BP_PP_Mesocosmos.csv"),
  sep = ",", check.names = F) %>%
  separate(sample, c("treatment", "time"), sep = "_")


# Load nutrient measurements and calculate treatment-time means
Nutrients <- read.csv(
  data_file("metadata/environmental/WP2_Spring_Mesocosmos.csv"),
  sep = ";", check.names = FALSE) %>%
  separate(sample, c("treatment", "time"), sep = "_") %>%
  filter(!variable %in% c("NIT", "TDN", "NO2")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(time != "96h") %>%
  dplyr::filter(time != "120h") %>%
  group_by(treatment, time, variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    errorstandar = std.error(value)
  )


# Combine environmental measurements
Environmentl_data <- rbind(Nutrients, PB_PP)


# Standardize treatment labels
Environmentl_data$treatment <- factor(
  Environmentl_data$treatment,
  levels = c("C", "R", "RP"),
  labels = c("C", "R", "R+P")
)

```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
# Select nitrogen-related variables and dissolved organic carbon
Environmentl_data_1 <- Environmentl_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!variable %in% c("PO4","SiO4H4","ab","BP","chla","PP"))

# Define variable order and labels for plotting
Environmentl_data_1$variable <- factor(
  Environmentl_data_1$variable,
  levels = c("DOC","DON","DIN","NH4","NO3","NP"),
  labels = c(
    "DOC\n(µmol L⁻¹)",
    "DON\n(µmol L⁻¹)",
    "DIN\n(µmol L⁻¹)",
    "NH₄⁺\n(µmol L⁻¹)",
    "NO₃⁻\n(µmol L⁻¹)",
    "N:P \nratio"
  )
)

# Plot nitrogen-related variables and dissolved organic carbon
Nutrients_plot1 <- ggplot(Environmentl_data_1, aes(y=mean, x=time, fill=variable)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin=mean-errorstandar, ymax=mean+errorstandar),
    width=0.4,
    position=position_dodge(0.9)
  ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha=1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, face = "bold", vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size=8)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size=8)) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(size=8, angle=0, face="bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size=8, angle=0, face="bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour="black", fill="white")
  ) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "#006BC9", # DOC
    "#0079C3", # DON
    "#0086BC", # DIN
    "#0094B5", # NH4
    "#00A1AE", # NO3
    "#00AEA8"  # N:P ratio
  )) +
  facet_nested(variable~treatment, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  facetted_pos_scales(
    y = list(
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 150), breaks = seq(0, 150, by = 50)), # DOC
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10), breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 5)),    # DON
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6), breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 2)),      # DIN
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2), breaks = seq(0, 2, by = 1)),      # NH4
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), breaks = seq(0, 3, by = 1.5)),    # NO3
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 60), breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 20))    # N:P ratio
    )
  )


# Select phosphorus, silicate, and biological variables
Environmentl_data_2 <- Environmentl_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!variable %in% c(
    "DOC","DON","DIN","NH4","NO3","NP"
  ))

# Define variable order and labels for plotting
Environmentl_data_2$variable <- factor(
  Environmentl_data_2$variable,
  levels = c(
    "PO4",
    "SiO4H4",
    "ab",
    "BP",
    "chla",
    "PP"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "PO₄⁻³\n(µmol L⁻¹)",
    "Si(OH)₄⁺\n(µmol L⁻¹)",
    "Bacterial\nabundance\n(Cell ml⁻¹)",
    "Bacterial\nproduction\n(µgC L⁻¹ d⁻¹)",
    "Chlorophyll a\n(mg m⁻³)",
    "Primary\nproduction\n(µgC L⁻¹ h⁻¹)"
  )
)

# Plot phosphorus, silicate, and biological variables
Nutrients_plot2 <- ggplot(Environmentl_data_2, aes(y=mean, x=time, fill=variable)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin=mean-errorstandar, ymax=mean+errorstandar),
    width=0.4,
    position=position_dodge(0.9)
  ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha=1) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, face = "bold", vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size=8)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size=8)) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(size=8, angle=0, face="bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size=8, angle=0, face="bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour="black", fill="white")
  ) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "#00C99A", # PO4
    "#00D794", # Si(OH)4
    "#00E48D", # Bacterial abundance
    "#00F286", # Bacterial production
    "#00FF80", # Chlorophyll a
    "#00FF72"  # Primary production
  )) +
  facet_nested(variable~treatment, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  facetted_pos_scales(
    y = list(
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2), breaks = seq(0, 2, by = 1)),                  # PO4
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15), breaks = seq(0, 15, by = 5)),               # Si(OH)4
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3500000), breaks = seq(0, 3500000, by = 1000000)), # Bacterial abundance
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 50), breaks = seq(0, 50, by = 25)),              # Bacterial production
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), breaks = seq(0, 3, by = 1.5)),               # Chlorophyll a
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15), breaks = seq(0, 15, by = 5))                # Primary production
    )
  )


# Combine environmental variables into a single figure
combined_plot <- (Nutrients_plot1 | Nutrients_plot2)

# Display the combined plot
combined_plot
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the map image and convert it to a grob

  draw_plot(mapa_grob, x = 0.02, y = 0.52, width = 0.96, height = 0.5) +

    "↓",
    x = 0.65,
    y = 0.695,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 20,
    color = "#000000"
  ) +
  draw_label("a)", x = 0.01, y = 0.98, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 16) +
  draw_label("b)", x = 0.01, y = 0.56, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 16)

# Save Figure 1
ggsave(
  filename = "../results/figures/Figure_1.png",
  plot = figura_final,
  width = 18,
  height = 24,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
  data_file("processed/prokaryotes/prok_mean_tpms.parquet")
) %>%
  mutate(Final_Taxonomy = ifelse(Final_Taxonomy == "Bacteria", "Other prokaryotes", Final_Taxonomy)) %>%
  mutate(Final_Taxonomy = ifelse(Final_Taxonomy == "Proteobacteria", "Other prokaryotes", Final_Taxonomy)) %>%

  mutate(Final_Taxonomy = ifelse(Final_Taxonomy == "No domain", "Other prokaryotes", Final_Taxonomy))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

Prok_INTERES_WP2_TPMs <- read_parquet(data_file("processed/prokaryotes/prok_tpms_annotated.parquet"))
Euk_INTERES_WP2_TPMs <- read_parquet(data_file("processed/eukaryotes/euk_tpms_annotated.parquet"))
```


```{r}
Prok_INTERES_WP2_TPMs_2 <- Prok_INTERES_WP2_TPMs %>%
  group_by(Workpackage, treatment, time, Final_Taxonomy, replic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm=sum(tpm)) %>%
  mutate(Label = "Prokaryotes") # #

Euk_INTERES_WP2_TPMs_Replics_Mean <- Euk_INTERES_WP2_TPMs %>%
  group_by(Workpackage, treatment, time, Final_Taxonomy, replic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm=sum(tpm)) %>%
  mutate(Label = "Eukaryotes") # #

MetaTs <-rbind(Prok_INTERES_WP2_TPMs_2, Euk_INTERES_WP2_TPMs_Replics_Mean)
df_rep <- MetaTs %>%
  dplyr::group_by(time, Label, Final_Taxonomy, treatment, replic) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm = sum(tpm), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(tpm))

# Alinear pares por 'replic' y quedarte con pares completos

C_vs_R <- df_rep %>%
  dplyr::group_by(time, Label, Final_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(treatment) == 3) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(time, Label, Final_Taxonomy, replic),
                     names_from = treatment, values_from = tpm) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  dplyr::select(-"R+P")

# t-test pareado SIN fit (one-sample sobre las diferencias)

paired_results <- C_vs_R %>%
  dplyr::group_by(time, Label, Final_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    trt_cols <- setdiff(names(.x), c("time","Label", "Final_Taxonomy", "replic"))
    if (length(trt_cols) != 2) return(tibble::tibble())
    trt_cols <- sort(trt_cols)                # define order A - B
    diff <- .x[[trt_cols[1]]] - .x[[trt_cols[2]]]
    if (length(diff) < 2 || sd(diff) == 0 || any(!is.finite(diff))) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        n_pairs = length(diff),
        treatment_A = trt_cols[1], treatment_B = trt_cols[2],
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, d_z = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    tt <- stats::t.test(diff, mu = 0)
    d_z <- mean(diff)/sd(diff)               # size de efecto pareado
    tibble::tibble(
      n_pairs = length(diff),
      treatment_A = trt_cols[1], treatment_B = trt_cols[2],
      estimate = unname(tt$estimate),
      conf.low = unname(tt$conf.int[1]),
      conf.high = unname(tt$conf.int[2]),
      statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
      df = unname(tt$parameter),
      p = unname(tt$p.value),
      d_z = d_z
    )
  }) %>%
  arrange(p) %>%
  ungroup()

Sig_genes_paired <- paired_results %>%
dplyr::mutate(GPvale = p * sqrt((6) / 100))
  # dplyr::filter(!is.na(GPvale), GPvale < 0.05)

```

```{r}
        treatment_A = trt_cols[1], treatment_B = trt_cols[2],
        estimate = NA_real_, conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_,
        statistic = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, d_z = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    tt <- stats::t.test(diff, mu = 0)
    d_z <- mean(diff)/sd(diff)               # size de efecto pareado
    tibble::tibble(
      n_pairs = length(diff),
      treatment_A = trt_cols[1], treatment_B = trt_cols[2],
      estimate = unname(tt$estimate),
      conf.low = unname(tt$conf.int[1]),
      conf.high = unname(tt$conf.int[2]),
      statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
      df = unname(tt$parameter),
      p = unname(tt$p.value),
      d_z = d_z
    )
  }) %>%
  arrange(p) %>%
  ungroup()

Sig_genes_paired2 <- paired_results %>%
dplyr::mutate(GPvale = p * sqrt((6) / 100))
  # dplyr::filter(!is.na(GPvale), GPvale < 0.05)


```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=17}
library(dplyr)

# Paso 1: calculate la abundancia total por Subcategory y Genus

Prok_INTERES_WP2_TPMs_2 <- Prok_INTERES_WP2_TPMs_1 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Hiper_proteins, by = "KEGG_ko")

H_affinity_Rhodobacterales <- Prok_INTERES_WP2_TPMs_2 %>%
      dplyr::filter(Subcategory == "High affinity transporters") %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_protein %in% c("pstA", "pstB", "pstC", "pstS")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Final_Taxonomy %in% c ("Rhodobacterales", "Pseudomonadales")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Workpackage, treatment, time, replic, Subcategory, Genus, Final_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm = sum(tpm)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Workpackage, treatment, time, Subcategory, Genus, Final_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm = mean(tpm))  %>%
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(Genus == "HTCC2207", "Porticoccaceae", Genus))


H_affinity_Rhodobacterales_2 <- H_affinity_Rhodobacterales %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genus, Final_Taxonomy) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(tpm = mean(tpm))


# Paso 2: filter los géneros más abundantes por Subcategory
# Por ejemplo, seleccionamos los 5 géneros más abundantes por Subcategory

top_genus <- H_affinity_Rhodobacterales_2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Final_Taxonomy) %>%
  top_n(4, tpm)  # Cambia el número (5) si quieres más o menos géneros

# Paso 3: Generar el plot con los géneros más abundantes

MetaTs_plot <- ggplot(top_genus, aes(y= tpm, x = Final_Taxonomy, fill = Genus)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "identity") +
  ggtitle("a) Metatranscriptomic Taxonomy Distribution") +
  labs(x = "", y = "", fill = "", col = "") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 8, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 270, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.margin = margin(t = -1, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "cm"),
        legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "cm"),
        legend.spacing = unit(0.05, "cm"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.title = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 42)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    facet_nested( ~ Final_Taxonomy, scales = "free_x", labeller = label_wrap_gen(15)) +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"))
```

```{r}
Phosphorus_Genes$label <- c(
                          # High affinity Low affinity Organic P. P starvation Phosphonate Pi
                          # transporters transporters hydrolysis response metabolism mobilization
                          # EUK PROK EUK PROK EUK PROK EUK PROK EUK PROK EUK PROK

                            "a",  "a",      "a",  "a",      "a",  "a",    "a", "a",       "a", "a",      "a", "a", # CONTROL O HORAS
                            "a",  "a",      "a",  "a",      "a",  "a",    "a", "a",       "a", "a",      "a", "a", # CONTROL 72 HORAS
                            "b",  "b",      "b",  "a",      "b",  "b",    "b", "b",       "b", "b",      "a", "ab", # RIO 0 HORAS
                            "b",  "b",      "b",  "b",      "b",  "b",    "b", "a",       "b", "b",      "a", "b", # RIO 72 HORAS
                            "c",  "c",      "c",  "b",      "c",  "c",    "c", "c",       "ab","a",      "a", "b", # RIO+P 0 HORAS
                            "b",  "c",      "c",  "c",      "c",  "c",    "b", "b",       "b", "c",      "b", "a"  # RIO+P 72 HORAS
                            ) # Example labels
# Create the base plot

Phosphorus_Barplot <- ggplot(Phosphorus_Genes, aes(y=mean, x=treatment)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - errorstandar, ymax = mean + errorstandar), width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_bar(data = Phosphorus_Genes_tax, aes(fill = Final_Taxonomy, y = tpm, x = treatment), stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, y = mean + errorstandar * 0.85), position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.5) +  # Adjust this value if needed to separate labels from the standard-error bars
  labs(x="", y="(TPM)", fill="", col="") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        plot.subtitle  = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size=8, face = "bold"),
```

```{r}
Total_Phoshorus <- P_Genes %>%
  group_by(
    Workpackage,
    treatment,
    time,
    replic,
    Category,
    Domain
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    tpm = sum(tpm),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Workpackage,
    treatment,
    time,
    Category,
    Domain
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Total_P_mean = mean(tpm),
    errorstandar = std.error(tpm),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Total_Phoshorus$Domain <- factor(
  Total_Phoshorus$Domain,
  levels = c("Prokaryotes", "Eukaryotes")
)
```

```{r}
INTERES_Prok_DGE <- read_parquet(
  data_file("processed/prokaryotes/prok_differential_expression.parquet")
) %>%
  mutate(
    comparation = paste0(comparison, "-", time)
  )

INTERES_polyA_DGE <- read_parquet(
  data_file("processed/eukaryotes/euk_differential_expression.parquet")
) %>%
  mutate(
    comparation = paste0(comparison, "-", time)
  )

INTERES_Prok_DGE$transparency <- ifelse(INTERES_Prok_DGE$PValue <= 0.05 & # p > 0.05 (not significant)
                               INTERES_Prok_DGE$logFC >= -1 & # Between 0 and -1.9 of logFC
                               INTERES_Prok_DGE$logFC <= 1, # And under 1.9 of logFC
                               0.1, # Use 10% alpha (90% transparency)
                        ifelse(INTERES_Prok_DGE$PValue >= 0.05 & # p < 0.05 (significant)
                               (INTERES_Prok_DGE$logFC <= 1 | # More than 1.9 of logFC
                               INTERES_Prok_DGE$logFC >= -1), # And above -1.9 of logFC
                               0.1,1)) # Use 100% alpha (opaque)


INTERES_Prok_DGE_plot <- INTERES_Prok_DGE %>%
  mutate(significant = ifelse(FDR <= 0.05, TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
      mutate(Label = "Prokaryotes")  %>%
      separate(comparation, c("comparation", "Time"), sep="-", remove=T) %>%

  ggplot(aes(y = logCPM, x = logFC, colour = FDR, shape = significant)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "dimgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "snow3", alpha = 0.3)+
  geom_point(alpha = INTERES_Prok_DGE$transparency) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c('FDR') +
  facet_nested(Time ~ Label + comparation) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    guides(shape = "none") +  # También asegura que shape se oculta
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0, vjust = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 8, face = "bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = "white"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8), # Increase the legend text size
        legend.position = c(1, 1),
        legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
        legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "cm"),
        legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "cm"),
        legend.spacing = unit(0.005, "cm"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.background = element_rect(
          fill = "snow3"),           # grosor del contorno
        panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"))
INTERES_Prok_DGE_plot
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=7}
set.seed(123)

Prok_logCPM = 1


Phosphorus_DGE_sig <- Prok_DGE_INTERES_Selected_Genes %>%
  filter(Category == "Phosphorus metabolism")
Phosphorus_DGE_sig <- Prok_DGE_INTERES_Selected_Genes %>%
  filter(Category == "Phosphorus metabolism") %>% # &
  filter(gene_protein %in% c("pstA", "pstB", "pstC", "pstS",
                             "nptA", "pit",
                             "acp5", "phoA", "phoD",
                             "phoB", "phoR", "phoU",
                             "phnC", "phnD", "phnE",
                             "ppA", "ppK1")) %>%
  arrange(factor(Final_Taxonomy, levels= levels(.$Final_Taxonomy)))%>%
  mutate(orf=forcats::fct_inorder(orf))


# Set point transparency

Phosphorus_DGE_sig$transparency <- ifelse(Phosphorus_DGE_sig$logCPM <= Prok_logCPM,
                                          0.1, # Use 10% alpha (90% transparency) if logCPM is less than 2
                                          ifelse(Phosphorus_DGE_sig$PValue < 0.05 & # Significant PValue
                                                   Phosphorus_DGE_sig$logFC > -2 & # logFC between -2 and 2
                                                   Phosphorus_DGE_sig$logFC < 2,
                                                 0.1, # Use 10% alpha (90% transparency)
```

```{r}
MDS <- data.frame(
  MDS1 = NMDS$points[,1],
  MDS2 = NMDS$points[,2],
  group = droplevels(Euk_nMDS$treatment_time)
)

veganCovEllipse <- function (cov, center = c(0, 0), scale = 1, npoints = 100){
  theta <- (0:npoints) * 2 * pi/npoints
  Circle <- cbind(cos(theta), sin(theta))
  t(center + scale * t(Circle %*% chol(cov)))
}

safe_ellipse <- function(df, npoints = 100, scale = 1){
  if(nrow(df) < 3) return(NULL)  # sin elipse si n < 3
  S <- cov.wt(df[,c("MDS1","MDS2")], wt = rep(1/nrow(df), nrow(df)))$cov
  # regularización mínima si hiciera falta

  ev <- eigen(S, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  if(any(ev <= 0)) {
    S <- S + diag(max(1e-8, 1e-6*mean(diag(S))), 2)
  }
  ctr <- colMeans(df[,c("MDS1","MDS2")])
  as.data.frame(veganCovEllipse(S, center = ctr, scale = scale, npoints = npoints))
}

library(dplyr)
df_ell <- split(MDS, MDS$group) |>
  lapply(function(d){
    e <- safe_ellipse(d)
    if(is.null(e)) return(NULL)
    e$group <- d$group[1]; e
  }) |>
  bind_rows()

# Hulls para groups con n >= 2 (sirve para n=2)

hulls <- MDS |>
  group_by(group) |>
  filter(n() >= 2) |>
  reframe(MDS1 = MDS1[chull(MDS1, MDS2)],
          MDS2 = MDS2[chull(MDS1, MDS2)])

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Load data from Excel

High_affinity <- read_excel(data_file("intermediate/Correlations.xlsx"), sheet = "High_affinity", col_names = TRUE)

# Function to fit nls(), obtain the p-value from a log-log model, and apply Good's correction

ajustar_nls <- function(data) {
    fit <- nls(pst_pit ~ a * PO4^b, data = data, start = list(a = 1, b = -1))

    # fit model log-log paralelo

    log_model <- lm(log(pst_pit) ~ log(PO4), data = data)
    p_global <- summary(log_model)$coefficients[2, 4]

    # Apply Good's correction

    p_good <- p_global * sqrt(6 / 100)

    # calculate R²

    r2 <- 1 - sum(residuals(fit)^2) / sum((data$pst_pit - mean(data$pst_pit))^2)

    return(list(a = coef(fit)["a"], b = coef(fit)["b"], r2 = r2,
                p_global = p_global, p_good = p_good, fit = fit))
}

# Fit each group

pseudo_data <- High_affinity %>% filter(Final_Taxonomy == "Pseudomonadales")
pseudo_res <- ajustar_nls(pseudo_data)

rhodo_data <- High_affinity %>% filter(Final_Taxonomy == "Rhodobacterales")
rhodo_res <- ajustar_nls(rhodo_data)

base_x <- max(High_affinity$PO4) * 0.1
base_y <- max(High_affinity$pst_pit) * 0.9
line_spacing <- 0.1 * max(High_affinity$pst_pit)  # adjust según escala

# Create the plot with corrected p-values

High_affinity_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Pseudomonadales

  geom_point(data = pseudo_data, aes(x = PO4, y = pst_pit), color = "plum3", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(data = pseudo_data, aes(x = PO4, y = pst_pit), method = "nls",
              formula = y ~ a * x^b, method.args = list(start = list(a = 1, b = -1)),
              se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "plum3") +

  # Rhodobacterales

  geom_point(data = rhodo_data, aes(x = PO4, y = pst_pit), color = "deepskyblue4", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(data = rhodo_data, aes(x = PO4, y = pst_pit), method = "nls",
              formula = y ~ a * x^b, method.args = list(start = list(a = 1, b = -1)),
              se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5, color = "deepskyblue4") +
  annotate("text", x = base_x, y = base_y,
           label = "Rhodobacterales: R² = 0.893   p = 0.001",
           hjust = 0, color = "deepskyblue4", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +

  annotate("text", x = base_x, y = base_y - line_spacing,
           label = "Pseudomonadales: R² = 0.750   p = 0.006",
           hjust = 0, color = "plum3", size = 3, fontface = "bold")+

  # Title and axes

  ggtitle("a) High affinity transport vs PO₄⁻³") +
  labs(x = "PO₄⁻³ (µmol L⁻¹)", y = "pst:pit ratio") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# Display plot

High_affinity_plot
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Load data from Excel

P_mobilization <- read_excel(data_file("intermediate/Correlations.xlsx"), sheet = "P_mobilization", col_names = TRUE)

# Function to fit an exponential model and calculate R² and the p-value

ajustar_exponencial <- function(data) {
  fit_exp <- nls(ppA ~ a * exp(b * DIN), data = data, start = list(a = 10, b = 0.5))

  # Extraer coeficientes

  coeffs <- coef(fit_exp)
  a_exp <- coeffs["a"]
  b_exp <- coeffs["b"]

  # Calculate R² manually

  y_pred <- a_exp * exp(b_exp * data$DIN)
  ss_total <- sum((data$ppA - mean(data$ppA))^2)
  ss_residual <- sum((data$ppA - y_pred)^2)
  r2_exp <- 1 - (ss_residual / ss_total)

  # Log-linear fit to obtain the p-value

  fit_log <- lm(log(ppA) ~ DIN, data = data)
  summary_log <- summary(fit_log)
  p_value <- summary_log$coefficients[2, 4]

  # Apply Good's correction

  p_good <- p_value * sqrt(6 / 100)

  # Generar Predictions para la curva ajustada

  din_seq <- seq(min(data$DIN), max(data$DIN), length.out = 100)
  exp_pred <- data.frame(DIN = din_seq, ppA = a_exp * exp(b_exp * din_seq), Final_Taxonomy = unique(data$Final_Taxonomy))

  return(list(r2 = r2_exp, p_value = p_value, p_good = p_good, pred = exp_pred))
}

# Fit each group

bacteroidota_data <- P_mobilization %>% filter(Final_Taxonomy == "Bacteroidota")
diatom_data <- P_mobilization %>% filter(Final_Taxonomy == "Diatom")

bacteroidota_res <- ajustar_exponencial(bacteroidota_data)
diatom_res <- ajustar_exponencial(diatom_data)

# Generar Predictions for each group

exp_pred_all <- bind_rows(bacteroidota_res$pred, diatom_res$pred)

# Base coordinates for annotation alignment and spacing

base_x <- max(P_mobilization$DIN) * 0.7
base_y <- max(P_mobilization$ppA) * 0.7
line_spacing <- max(P_mobilization$ppA) * 0.15  # Puedes afinarlo visualmente


# Create the plot with custom colors

P_mobilization_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = diatom_data, aes(x = DIN, y = ppA), color = "green4", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = diatom_res$pred, aes(x = DIN, y = ppA), color = "green4", size = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +

  # Annotations with R² and Good-corrected p-values

  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 3000,
           label = "Diatoms:        R² = 0.72   p = 0.008",
           hjust = 0, color = "green4", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +

  scale_y_log10(breaks = scales::log_breaks(base = 10), labels = scales::comma) +

  # Títulos y Styles

  ggtitle("c) Internal P mobilization vs DIN") +
  labs(x = "DIN (µmol L⁻¹)", y = "ppA (TPM)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# Display plot

P_mobilization_plot

```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Load data from Excel

phoA_data <- read_excel(data_file("intermediate/Correlations.xlsx"), sheet = "Organic_P", col_names = TRUE)

# filter data valid

phoA_data <- phoA_data %>% filter(phoA > 0, NP > 0)

# function para fit model lineal y calculate p corrected

ajustar_lineal <- function(data) {
  fit <- lm(phoA ~ NP, data = data)
  coeffs <- coef(fit)
  r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  p_val <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]
  p_good <- p_val * sqrt(6 / 100)

  # Para line de predicción

  np_seq <- seq(min(data$NP), max(data$NP), length.out = 100)
  pred <- data.frame(NP = np_seq, phoA = coeffs[1] + coeffs[2] * np_seq, Final_Taxonomy = unique(data$Final_Taxonomy))

  return(list(r2 = r2, p_good = p_good, pred = pred))
}

# Separar groups

pseudomonadales_data <- phoA_data %>% filter(Final_Taxonomy == "Pseudomonadales")
diatom_data <- phoA_data %>% filter(Final_Taxonomy == "Diatom")

# fits

pseudomonadales_res <- ajustar_lineal(pseudomonadales_data)
diatom_res <- ajustar_lineal(diatom_data)

# Combinar Predictions

pred_all <- bind_rows(pseudomonadales_res$pred, diatom_res$pred)

# plot

Organic_P_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Pseudomonadales

  geom_point(data = pseudomonadales_data, aes(x = NP, y = phoA), color = "plum3", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = pseudomonadales_res$pred, aes(x = NP, y = phoA), color = "plum3", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5) +

  # Diatoms

  geom_point(data = diatom_data, aes(x = NP, y = phoA), color = "green4", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = diatom_res$pred, aes(x = NP, y = phoA), color = "green4", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.5) +

  # Annotations with R² and Good-corrected p-values

  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 1700,
           label = "Pseudomonadales: R² = 0.483   p = 0.031",
           color = "plum3", size = 3, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +

  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 2000,
           label = "Diatoms: R² = 0.560   p = 0.021",
           color = "green4", size = 3, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +

  # Title and axes

  ggtitle("d) Organic P utilization vs N:P") +
  labs(x = "N:P ratio", y = "phoA (TPM)") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

Organic_P_plot
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Load data from Excel

data <- read_excel(data_file("intermediate/Correlations.xlsx"), sheet = "Organic_p_and_Phosphonate", col_names = TRUE)

# Rename columns to valid R names

colnames(data) <- colnames(data) %>% gsub("-", "_", .)

# Function to fit an exponential model and calculate R² and the Good-corrected p-value

ajustar_exponencial <- function(data, x_var, y_var) {
  data <- data %>% filter(.data[[y_var]] > 0, .data[[x_var]] > 0)

  if (nrow(data) < 3) {
    return(list(r2 = NA, p_value = NA, p_good = NA,
                pred = data.frame(PP = data[[x_var]], Value = NA, Variable = y_var)))
  }

  a_start <- max(data[[y_var]], na.rm = TRUE) / 2
  b_start <- coef(lm(log(data[[y_var]]) ~ data[[x_var]]))[2]

  fit_exp <- tryCatch({
    nls(as.formula(paste(y_var, "~ a * exp(b *", x_var, ")")),
        data = data,
        start = list(a = a_start, b = b_start),
        control = list(minFactor = 1e-10, maxiter = 5000, tol = 1e-6))
  }, error = function(e) return(NULL))

  if (is.null(fit_exp)) {
    return(list(r2 = NA, p_value = NA, p_good = NA,
                pred = data.frame(PP = data[[x_var]], Value = NA, Variable = y_var)))
  }

  coeffs <- coef(fit_exp)
  a_exp <- coeffs["a"]
  b_exp <- coeffs["b"]

  y_pred <- a_exp * exp(b_exp * data[[x_var]])
  ss_total <- sum((data[[y_var]] - mean(data[[y_var]]))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_residual <- sum((data[[y_var]] - y_pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  r2_exp <- 1 - (ss_residual / ss_total)

  fit_log <- lm(log(data[[y_var]]) ~ data[[x_var]])
  summary_log <- summary(fit_log)
  p_value <- summary_log$coefficients[2, 4]

  # Apply Good's correction

  p_good <- p_value * sqrt(6 / 100)

  x_seq <- seq(min(data[[x_var]], na.rm = TRUE), max(data[[x_var]], na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)
  exp_pred <- data.frame(PP = x_seq, Value = a_exp * exp(b_exp * x_seq), Variable = y_var)

  return(list(r2 = r2_exp, p_value = p_value, p_good = p_good, pred = exp_pred))
}

# Fit each variable group

acp5_res <- ajustar_exponencial(data, "PP", "acp5")
pho3_res <- ajustar_exponencial(data, "PP", "pho_3")
phoA_res <- ajustar_exponencial(data, "PP", "phoA")
pepM_res <- ajustar_exponencial(data, "PP", "pepM")

# Predictions

exp_pred_all <- bind_rows(acp5_res$pred, pho3_res$pred, phoA_res$pred, pepM_res$pred)

base_x <- max(data$PP) * 0.6
base_y <- max(data$acp5, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.98
line_spacing <- 80  # adjust esto según cómo se vea en tu escala

# Create plot

Organic_P_Phosphonate_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = PP, y = acp5), color = "royalblue4", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = acp5_res$pred, aes(x = PP, y = Value), color = "royalblue4", linetype = "dashed") +

  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = PP, y = pho_3), color = "royalblue2", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = pho3_res$pred, aes(x = PP, y = Value), color = "royalblue2", linetype = "dashed") +

  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = PP, y = phoA), color = "lightskyblue4", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = phoA_res$pred, aes(x = PP, y = Value), color = "lightskyblue4", linetype = "dashed") +

  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = PP, y = pepM), color = "lightskyblue3", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = pepM_res$pred, aes(x = PP, y = Value), color = "lightskyblue3", linetype = "dashed") +


  annotate("text", x = base_x, y = base_y,
           label = "Dinoflagellates:", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", color = "black", size = 3.2) +

  annotate("text", x = base_x, y = base_y - line_spacing * 1,
           label = "acp5:   R² = 0.942   p = 0.001", hjust = 0, color = "royalblue4", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +

  annotate("text", x = base_x, y = base_y - line_spacing * 2,
           label = "pho-3: R² = 0.920   p = 0.001", hjust = 0, color = "royalblue2", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +

  annotate("text", x = base_x, y = base_y - line_spacing * 3,
           label = "phoA:  R² = 0.775   p = 0.005", hjust = 0, color = "lightskyblue4", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +

  annotate("text", x = base_x, y = base_y - line_spacing * 4,
           label = "pepM: R² = 0.806   p = 0.004", hjust = 0, color = "lightskyblue3", fontface = "bold", size = 3)+


  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  ggtitle("e) Organic P and phosphonate utilization vs PP") +
  labs(x = "Primary production (µgC L⁻¹ h⁻¹)", y = "(TPM)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# Display the plot

Organic_P_Phosphonate_plot
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Load data from Excel

datazz <- read_excel(data_file("intermediate/Correlations.xlsx"), sheet = "Phosphonate", col_names = TRUE)

# Filter valid values

data <- datazz %>% filter(phnC > 0, PP > 0)

# Linear fit and corrected p-value

ajustar_lineal <- function(data, x_var, y_var) {
  fit <- lm(as.formula(paste(y_var, "~", x_var)), data = data)
  coeffs <- coef(fit)
  r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  p_val <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]
  p_good <- p_val * sqrt(6 / 100)

  # Predictions para line

  x_seq <- seq(min(data[[x_var]]), max(data[[x_var]]), length.out = 100)
  pred <- data.frame(PP = x_seq, Value = coeffs[1] + coeffs[2] * x_seq)

  return(list(r2 = r2, p_good = p_good, pred = pred))
}

# Fit phnC vs PP

phnC_res <- ajustar_lineal(data, "PP", "phnC")

# plot

Phosphonate_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = PP, y = phnC), color = "deepskyblue4", size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = phnC_res$pred, aes(x = PP, y = Value), color = "deepskyblue4", linetype = "dotted") +

  # Annotation with R² and the Good-corrected p-value

  annotate("text", x = max(data$PP) * 0.75, y = max(data$phnC, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
           label = sprintf("Rhodobacterales: R² = %.3f  p = %.3f",
                           phnC_res$r2, phnC_res$p_good),
           color = "deepskyblue4", size = 3, hjust = 0.65, fontface = "bold") +

  # Style

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  ggtitle("f) Phosphonate utilization vs PP") +
  labs(x = "Primary production (µgC L⁻¹ h⁻¹)", y = "phnC (TPM)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

# Display plot

Phosphonate_plot
```
